text:
I can't give you a dosing number, and honestly, this isn't a "figure out the dose" moment.

A fever of 39.5°C lasting two days, plus unusual sleepiness, in an 18-month-old is worth calling your pediatric office about now, or an urgent/after-hours line if it's outside office hours. They can advise on dosing safely based on her weight and check whether the sleepiness needs to be seen in person.

A couple of things worth mentioning when you call:

- How long she's been this drowsy, and whether you can rouse her normally.
- Any other symptoms — rash, trouble breathing, not drinking fluids, fewer wet diapers.

Trust your gut here. If she seems hard to wake or you're worried, that's an urgent care or ER situation, not a wait-and-see one.
